No. 2144/59 – FRIDAY, OCTOBER 11, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT ( CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:-

Under mention land is situated at Kaluvankerni Poomi Kaluvankerni Grama Niladari Division in Eravur Pattu Divisional Secretariat Batticaloa in Eastern Province and is Preliminary plan was prepared by Survey General and details in PP/Mada/2936 and extend of 4.1805 Hectares.
Lot No.01 Name of the land: Kaluvankerni Poomi; Usage at Present: Tsunami Resettlement; Claimant: Mr. Marcas Cooray; Extent: 4.1805 Hectares.
Boundaries : North: Kaluvankerni Poomi, Vempukkadu, Lot 11 in P.P. මඩ 810, TP 354278, Lot 83 in P. P; 5041, TP

324449, TP 324774 and TP 324415; East: TP 354278, Lot No. 83 in P.P. 5041, TP 324449, TP 324774,TP 324415, Lot 93 in P. P. 5041 and Lot 3086 in P.P. 4761; South: Lot 3086 in P. P. 4761, TP 203826, Lot 77786 in P.P. 2712 and Kaluvankerni Poomi; West: TP203826, Lot 77786 in P.P. 2712, Kaluvankerni Poomi, Vempukkadu and Lot 11in P.P. මඩ 810.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Eravur Pattu Divisional Secretariat on the 09th day of the December on 2019 at 10.00a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th day of November 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
N. VILVARATNAM, Divisional Secretary, Eravur Pattu,
Divisional Secretariat, Eravur Pattu, Chenkalady. 10-928

AMENDEMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My Reference No.: Ma/san/03/230. THE Notice published in the Extraordinary Gazette of Democratic Socialist Republicc of Sri Lanka No. 2094/1 on 22nd October, 2018, Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 4106 stated as Lot No. 28. It should be amended as Lot Nos. 130 and 131.
Lot No. 130 Name of the land: —; Description: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. Iresha Kumuduni Fernando, No. 496/2, Mudalige Mawatha, Ihala Karagamuna; Extent: 0.0032 Hectare.
Lot No. 131 Name of the land: Millagahawatta; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. Iresha Kumuduni
Fernando, No. 496/2, Mudalige Mawatha, Ihala Karagamuna; Extent: 0.0215 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land, Lot Nos. 130 and 131 are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Mahara on the 28th October 2019 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th October 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
G. S. I. WIMALASENA, Divisional Secretary, Mahara. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Mahara, 09th October, 2019. 10-93
